text: Reminds me of 'The Secrets Of Cornwall - Part 1 - Communications' : [VIDEO] All kinds of bland looking, unmarked buildings housing telecom equipment for the onshoring fibres.

story: Incenser, or how NSA and GCHQ are tapping internet cables (2014)
text: Great write up. I would recommend the checking out: Documentary about the cable landing stations: The Secrets of Cornwall [VIDEO]

A lot of the time these landing sites / buildings are a bit further inland. At the beach there is usually only a buried armoured cable leading to a concrete slab or something where it connects to underground ductwork. If you're interested in that and have an hour of time there is a youtube video[1] of a local tracking these down around the Cornwall area. [1] [VIDEO]
